title: Keeping Up With Science #2: Gene Editing & Bioethics (CRISPR)

teacherNotes.title: Session Goal
teacherNotes.content: Explore medical breakthroughs in gene therapy, genetic engineering, and ethical boundaries surrounding designer babies and disease eradication.

elements.content:
1. If genetic testing could predict disease risks later in life, would you want to know?
2. What comes to mind when you hear the term 'designer babies'?
3. Do humans have a moral responsibility to eradicate genetic diseases using technology?
Discuss the ethical limits of CRISPR gene editing:

• Curing inherited blindness vs. enhancing physical traits (height, intelligence).
• Should gene editing be accessible via public healthcare or reserved for private clinics?

elements.placeholder: Summarize your group's arguments regarding public healthcare access...
